term: equal standard for equally relevant evidence
definition: UniformStandard preserves epistemic verdicts only for pairs the supplied sameBasis relation identifies. SameScienceTheology supplies a particular such pair; interchange of theology and cosmology does not supply it. Differentiated experience can justify differentiated verdicts.
note: Bounded analytical vocabulary for #269. This definition fixes test semantics; source endorsement or normative adequacy is not established by naming it.
